app_fee.value: Not stated on the pages checked: PhD candidates apply to an advertised position, not through a fee-based application.

fee_waiver.value: Not stated on the pages checked

gre_general.value: The TU Delft PhD admission page does not mention the GRE.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 overall with 22 per section (tests before 21 Jan 2026), or 5 overall with 4.5 per section on the new scale (tests from 21 Jan 2026). Scores must be under two years old and are requested later in selection.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL test reports obtained from January 21, 2026: A TOEFL iBT with an overall band score of 5 and a minimum score of 4.5 for each section. | TOEFL test reports obtained before January 21, 2026: A TOEFL iBT with an overall band score of at least 100 and a minimum score of 22 for each section.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with at least 6.5 in each section; IELTS Online and Indicator are not accepted.
ielts_min.quote: An IELTS (academic version) with an overall band score of at least 7.0 and a minimum of 6.5 for each section

english_waiver.value: No country list: non-native applicants with an English-taught master's degree are in principle exempt, but may be asked to take a placement test at TU Delft if their English seems insufficient.
english_waiver.quote: Native speakers will be exempt from the English test requirement, as well as, in principle, non-native applicants who have obtained an English-taught Master’s degree. | If during the selection process it is deemed that the English proficiency of the candidate with an English-taught Master’s degree does not meet the requirements, they may also be asked to do a placement test.

notes: TU Delft charges a PhD tuition fee of EUR 11,000 per programme plus a bench fee, normally covered by the employing institute; the faculty may waive either.
